Removed upper bed/headboard pieces that rose above the roof cover and hid the schematic interior from the exterior preview.
Added an image-level caption to the cutaway stating that the interior is schematic and not an as-built plan.

Joined the complete exterior and schematic interior geometry into the stable House_301841248 root mesh so the named asset collection and scene each contain exactly one object, matching the current shared manifest object_count=1. Temporary preview camera/lights and caption are removed before save.
